verdict.rationale: Dover's docs cover all three parts of the story. Each job's interview plan takes custom stages with their own interviewers, templates and feedback forms. The candidate board lets you drag a card to another column to change its stage. Bulk actions apply the same change to many candidates at once. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, and no explicit evidence that bulk actions span the entire pipeline (all stages) rather than a selected set.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline

citations.quote: You add your own for each interview, assignment, or reference check. Each stage can have its own interviewers, duration, meeting type, email templates, and feedback form.
Drag a card to another column to move the candidate to that stage.
Bulk actions let you apply the same change to many people at once, instead of opening each profile.
